questions.stem: In cardiac muscle, rapid electrical impulse synchronization across cardiocytes occurs via:
options: B) Gap junctions in intercalated discs
questions.answer: B) Gap junctions in intercalated discs
questions.explanation: Intercalated disc gap junctions permit electrical syncytium.

questions.stem: Which collagen fibre type forms the main white inelastic structural bundle of tendons?
questions.explanation: Type I collagen forms thick white inelastic tendon bundles.

questions.stem: Cartilage matrix avascularity is actively maintained because chondrin secretes:
options: B) Anti-angiogenic factors inhibiting blood vessel invasion
questions.answer: B) Anti-angiogenic factors inhibiting blood vessel invasion
questions.explanation: Chondrin secretes anti-angiogenic signals keeping cartilage avascular.

questions.stem: Which structural tissue sheath directly encloses a bundle of muscle fibres called a fascicle?
questions.explanation: Perimysium encloses a fascicle of muscle fibers.

questions.stem: Action potential saltatory conduction leaping along myelinated nerve fibers requires high Na+ channel density at:
options: B) Uninsulated Nodes of Ranvier axolemma
questions.answer: B) Uninsulated Nodes of Ranvier axolemma
questions.explanation: Nodes of Ranvier have high Na+ channel density for leaping conduction.

questions.stem: Which cell type synthesizes humoral antibody immunoglobulins in connective tissue during infection?
Single-unit smooth muscle differs from multi-unit smooth muscle because single-unit muscle is:
options: B) Myogenic with gap junction electrical syncytium
questions.answer: B) Myogenic with gap junction electrical syncytium
questions.explanation: Single-unit smooth muscle acts as myogenic syncytium.

questions.stem: Long bone epiphysis differs from diaphysis because epiphysis contains:
options: B) Red hemopoietic marrow in spongy trabeculae
questions.answer: B) Red hemopoietic marrow in spongy trabeculae
questions.explanation: Epiphysis contains spongy bone with red blood-forming marrow.

questions.stem: Mature post-mitotic human neurones cannot undergo cellular division because they lack active:
questions.explanation: Mature neurones lose active centrioles after foetal development.

questions.stem: Longest skeletal muscle block in the human body is:
questions.explanation: Sartorius is the longest muscle in the human body.
